title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 26, 2026

NASA’s DONKI reported a new coronal mass ejection, so Sunny is taking a look at the outer corona.

☀️ CME start: September 26, 2026 at 15:24 UTC
💨 CME speed: 449 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: S-type (<500 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 13° (Narrow)

Eyes on the corona today. 👀☀️

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-2
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
